title: Batch queue safety measurement incomplete or stale

model.expr: ((max(time() - omi_batch_pipeline_metrics_refreshed_at_seconds{namespace="prod-omi-backend"}) >= bool 120) or vector(1)) + (count(omi_batch_pipeline_oldest_age_seconds{namespace="prod-omi-backend"} != omi_batch_pipeline_oldest_age_seconds{namespace="prod-omi-backend"}) or vector(0)) + (count(omi_batch_pipeline_retry_age_seconds{namespace="prod-omi-backend"} != omi_batch_pipeline_retry_age_seconds{namespace="prod-omi-backend"}) or vector(0))

annotations.summary: Batch queue safety cannot measure every queue/retry priority, or its sample has been stale for two minutes.
annotations.user_impact: Late batch transcripts may go unnoticed while a bounded scan is saturated or the worker sample is unavailable.
annotations.scope: Production queue freshness and oldest/retry NaN samples. A saturated exempt prefix is incomplete, never proven late work or a healthy empty queue.
annotations.verification: Inspect batch_safety metrics_blind and queue sample freshness; count the unmeasured priority with ro-prod metadata aggregates.
annotations.safe_next_action: Classify the saturated prefix and real overdue work; retain all held audio and custody. Do not delete rows, reset paid intents, or waive allowance to silence the alarm.
annotations.evaluated_bad: Synthetic: one oldest or retry NaN priority alongside a finite zero, or no successful queue sample for two minutes.
annotations.evaluated_good: Synthetic: all priority age samples are finite and the queue sample is fresh.
